name: Safari
tagline: Savanna sunsets, lodge decks and wildlife at a respectful distance.
description: A once-in-a-lifetime safari: open-top game drives, acacia sunsets, waterhole lodges, giraffes and elephants at a respectful distance, a balloon over the Masai Mara, tented camps, bush dinners and Kilimanjaro on the horizon. Linen, khaki and warm golden light.
